# Donors in scope for the PEAR-TREE sample catalogue.
#
# *** GENERATED FILE -- DO NOT EDIT THE DONOR LIST BY HAND. ***
#   bash cluster/trees/make_donors_txt.sh            # regenerate from donor_table.tsv
#   bash cluster/trees/make_donors_txt.sh --check    # fail if stale
# This prose block is cluster/donors.header and IS hand-edited. The list below it is not.
#
# WHY GENERATED. Hand-maintained, this file drifted to 97 donors while the tree catalogue
# reached 151 -- and the 54 it lagged by included the ENTIRE 34-donor liver cohort and both
# tonsil donors. They were never scanned, so the catalogue reported them as having no BAMs.
# That is not a finding, it is an unasked question wearing the costume of one. The drift was
# invisible because both files looked internally consistent. Regenerated 2026-07-17: 150.
#
# DERIVED FROM TREE TIP LABELS + the published cohorts, not from filenames or memory.
#   spar_2ndrev/human/trees.rds                       (92 donors, PD-named)
#   JAK2_HNRNPA1_paper/.../mpn_trees/PD_MPN_CUT.RDS   (12 MPN donors)
#   spar_2ndrev/human/all_trees/*.tree                (116 files, study codenames)
# Rebuild: cluster/trees/master.R + dedup.R.  Tip->donor map: cluster/trees/tips.tsv
# Clinical detail per donor: cluster/trees/donor_clinical.tsv (paper-derived, and the
# authority -- the one-line notes below are only a summary of it).
#
# SCOPE != USABILITY. Every donor with a tree is listed, including ones already known to be
# unusable for a phylogeny (PD60243 is bulk-only; the three Fabre donors are targeted bulk,
# not WGS colonies). Scanning is how their BAM headers CONFIRM that, instead of us trusting a
# note. Discovery must exclude them; the catalogue scan must not.
#
# 150 PD ids here + AX001 = 151 catalogue donors. AX001 is deliberately absent: its colonies
# are named BMH1_TG001_* with no PD id, so the scan's glob would find nothing and report a
# clean zero. They come in via `--samples ~/ax001.samples`. Its PD-named samples DO glob and
# are listed under PD43976 -- the same person (see below).
#
# CODENAME = PD ID (verified by identical tip sets; treating a codename as a separate donor
# double-counts): KX004=PD45534 KX001=PD40521 KX002=PD40667 CB002=PD45517 KX008=PD48402
# SX001=PD41048 KX003=PD43974 PX001=PD47703 PX002=PD44579 PX003=PD50307 Tree_8pcw=PD43947
# KX009=PD49236 KX010=PD49237 PX004=PD50308 PX005=PD47537 PX007=PD37580 AX001=PD43976
#   The second line was established 2026-07-17 from the Mitchell 2025 trees on **Mendeley
#   10.17632/2fczcd49yj.1** -- each codename tree has a tip set IDENTICAL to the PD-named one.
#   NB the Zenodo DOI in our notes (10.5281/zenodo.15235476) is the CODE repo: it holds exactly
#   one donor's tree (PD37580). Mendeley is where the cohort's 44 trees are.
#   See cluster/trees/mitchell2025/README.md.
# AX001=BMH1_TG (361 tips, all named BMH1_TG001_*) = **PD43976 -- PROVEN 2026-07-17**
#   The Mitchell 2025 tree file named `PD43976.tree` (Mendeley 10.17632/2fczcd49yj.1) has tips
#   named `BMH1_TG001_P31_A11` etc. The tree named for the PD id CONTAINS the codename's
#   colonies. That is direct evidence, not inference; no BAM check needed.
#   Corroborating: Mitchell 2025 Supp T1 has PD43976 = "Peripheral blood | 63 | M | Normal -
#   previously published"; Mitchell 2022 Supp T1 has AX001 = 63/Male; Machado 2022 states
#   AX001 "was the same person as that enrolled in our earlier study of HSC dynamics".
#   CONSEQUENCE: AX001 and PD43976 are ONE donor under two naming schemes, in DIFFERENT
#   projects (BMH1_TG001_* in 2315/2445/2318; PD43976* in 2314/3231/3301/3369/3837). Do not
#   count them as two donors. ~/ax001.samples should hold the BMH1_TG001_* samples.
#
# A TREE IS THE ONLY RELIABLE EVIDENCE OF CLONALITY. The `_lo` naming convention is not:
# PD45534's colonies are letter-coded (aoj, ww, my2) and have a 922-tip tree.
#
# TREE DEPTH IS NOT TISSUE. Median root->tip SNVs = tissue x age x CHEMOTHERAPY. Several
# high-depth donors here are chemo-exposed blood, not crypts (Mitchell 2025). Do not infer
# tissue from depth alone.
#
# COHORTS
#  Machado 2022 Nature 608:724     lymphocytes; KX001/2/3, AX001, CB001, TX001/2; GRCh37d5
#                                  EGAD00001008107. Lymphocytes = EXTRA TISSUE from donors
#                                  whose HSC trees we already have.
#  Fabre 2022 Nature 606:335       longitudinal CH (SardiNIA); PD41276/PD34493/PD41305.
#                                  *** CORRECTED 2026-07-17: this study is TARGETED DEEP
#                                  SEQUENCING of bulk blood across 5 study phases. It has NO
#                                  WGS colonies. The old note here said "96 colonies each" --
#                                  that was WRONG and would have put bulk data into a
#                                  colony-phylogeny pipeline. Supp Table 2 holds VAF
#                                  trajectories, not colonies. NCBI build37.
#  Mitchell 2025 Nat Genet         CHEMOTHERAPY, 23 exposed + 9 controls; build37;
#                                  EGAD00001015339 (WGS) / EGAD00001015340 (NanoSeq).
#                                  **TREES: Mendeley 10.17632/2fczcd49yj.1** -- all 44 of them.
#                                  NOT zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15235476, which is the CODE repo
#                                  and holds exactly ONE donor's tree (PD37580). The paper's
#                                  own wording draws the line: Zenodo/github = "smaller derived
#                                  datasets"; Mendeley = "the main data needed to reanalyze and
#                                  reproduce the results". See cluster/trees/mitchell2025/.
#  Spencer Chapman 2024 Nature 635 transplant, 10 donor-recipient PAIRS = Pair* trees;
#                                  PD45792-PD45813. Each Pair is TWO people.
#  Kamizela 2025 Nature 640:982    BCR::ABL1 CML; GRCh38; EGAD00001015353;
#                                  github nangalialab/CML has the sample manifest + trees.
